focusTitle: Test your candidate from the opponent's side
whyNow: A forcing reply appeared after {{positions}} critical decisions in {{games}} of your 50 validation games. That shows the event, not its cause.
learnToday: After choosing a candidate, rebuild the position and find the most forcing reply before committing.
applyRulePreview: Signal: when an important piece changes square, look for captures and checks on that piece.
evidencePractice: Practice: success with fewer hints on guided positions.
evidenceGeneralization: Generalization: first attempt on unseen positions (server-protected holdout).
evidenceTransfer: Transfer: events in 10+0 games after v2 dose (when volume allows).
evidenceNote: One correct move is not mastery. Legacy bundle exposure may be unknown.
engineRequired: Coach service requires the local engine (npm run dev).
holdoutExposureNote: Holdout never sends the solution before your answer. Prior exposure to the exercise corpus may be uncertain.
holdoutRevealGeneric: Response recorded. Comparative feedback appears only after you close your attempt.
phaseSignal: Training signal: when an important piece changes square, rebuild and look for captures and checks on that square before committing.
phaseContrastSafe: Safe contrast: play a candidate that, in verified reference, does not allow an immediate capture on the moved piece.
phaseContrastUnsafeIntro: Unsafe contrast: next we apply your real move, which did allow an immediate hostile reply. We are not revealing the refutation yet—only contrasting patterns.
progressSubtitle: Separate channels. Legacy Beta mastery is hidden by default.

hypothesis.consistent: Self-report and short task align (tentative hypothesis).
hypothesis.contradicted: Self-report and short task disagree (tentative hypothesis).

realGamesChannelNote: Only games after qualified v2 dose; exercises do not count.
phaseRetentionCandidate: Retention: play your candidate with no hints.
phaseRetentionReply: Retention: find the most awkward opponent reply.
phaseRetentionComplete: Retention logged. Close to update evidence and v2 dose.
feedbackContrastTrySafe: Try the safe reference alternative (queen pawn capture).
feedbackContrastSafeOk: Safe contrast: no immediate capture on the queen on e4.
feedbackRetentionOk: Retention: first attempt logged without hints.
feedbackRetentionPartial: Retention logged; review the opponent reply.
phaseWorkedApply: We'll apply your real candidate and switch to the opponent.
phaseWorkedFindReply: As the opponent: what capture or check targets the piece that just moved?
phaseProbeSelf: Before Qg4 in the game, had you seen Nxg4? (self-report, not a definitive diagnosis)

probe.saw_but_continued: Yes, but I thought it worked
probe.saw_on_board: I only saw it when moving here

probeTaskRecognition: Without applying the move yet: which opponent piece could capture on g4? Play that reply as White from the start position.
probeTaskVisualization: Before moving: predict the most awkward capture on g4. Play it from the start position.
probeTaskEvaluation: Predict the most awkward reply; we'll compare material in feedback.
phaseExplore: Try another candidate from the start position.
phaseExploreReply: Now find the reply that worries you most.
phasePracticeReply: Find the most awkward opponent reply.
phaseHoldoutCandidate: Independent check: play the candidate you would choose.
phaseHoldoutReply: Find the most awkward reply. No opening hints.
phaseExitRule: Pick the rule you'll use in your next game:
exitRuleA: After moving an important piece, I first look for captures and checks on that square.
exitRuleB: I don't commit until I imagine a concrete hostile reply.
phaseSummary: v2 session logged. See evidence channels below. Retention due in 7–14 days.
feedbackTryAgain: Try another capture or check on the active piece.
feedbackProbeOk: Good: you separated anticipation and recognition.
feedbackProbePartial: Logged: we'll keep contrasting on the board.
feedbackNowFindReply: Candidate applied. Find the opponent reply.
feedbackSafeCandidate: Solid candidate: survives the first hostile check in the reference.
feedbackExploreMixed: Logged: check whether the candidate allows an immediate capture.
feedbackHoldoutPartial: First attempt recorded; see comparative reveal.

plan.title: Your training plan
plan.error: We could not refresh your plan. Retry to use the latest evidence.
plan.needs_analysis: Your games still need analysis. You can start with fundamentals without implying a detected weakness.
plan.observing: There is not enough evidence of a recurring pattern yet. While we keep observing, you can train fundamentals.
plan.generalNote: A general lesson on checking the opponent’s reply. This is not a new diagnosis of your games.
plan.method: Recurring patterns are prioritized by impact, previous practice and pending reviews. Solving one exercise does not demonstrate mastery.

reason.scheduled: Review scheduled; you can practice earlier
